zh.text: 根據前日本央行理事的說法，日本銀行很可能在明年中之前再加息三次至2%，達到1993年以來未見的水平。

en.text: The Bank of Japan will likely raise its benchmark interest rate three more times to 2% through the middle of next year, taking it to a level not seen since 1993, according to a former BOJ board member.

zh.text: AI相關超過5萬億美元資本支出複合體似乎即將出現破產潮。這會壓低通臀預期並觸發降息/量化寬鬆。

en.text: A bankruptcy wave seems close at hand for the AI related $5+ trillion capex complex. Would drag down inflation expectations and trigger rate cuts/QE.

zh.text: 十二月日曆決定下一階段走勢。12月1日周二：$MRVL和$CRDO財報，市場將解讀指引而非季度業績。12月4日周五：11月就業數據，在通脹數據偏熱後，強勁數據保持加息路徑。聯儲12月9日決定，加息為基準情況。11月CPI在12月10日聯儲決定後一天公布。隨後一週$MU和$BB於12月17日財報，JPM領口期權12月31日到期。市場需要前兩個不要出錯。

en.text: December calendar decides the next leg. Tuesday Dec 1: $MRVL and $CRDO earnings, market will read the guides not the quarters. Friday Dec 4: November payrolls after hot inflation print, strong number keeps hike path alive. Fed decides Dec 9, hike is the base case. November CPI prints Dec 10 one day after Fed. Following week $MU and $BB earnings Dec 17, JPM collar expires Dec 31. Market needs the first two not to go wrong.

zh.text: 硅谷「神皇帝」幻想只是沒有研究歷史的人對善變CEO的吹捧。Jensen和Elon的支持者被視為不良投資者，只為alpha而錢，因為他們不知道如何選股。引用@lessin關於Niall Ferguson對AI建設視為鐵路及生產力奇蹟的懷疑。

en.text: The Silicon Valley "god emperor" fantasy is just people who haven't studied history sucking up to mercurial CEOs. The Jensen and Elon supporters are seen for what they are: bad investors money grubbing for alpha because they don't know how to pick stocks. Quoted from @lessin on Niall Ferguson skeptical of AI buildout as railroads and productivity miracle.

zh.text: James56487175回覆，在本地低點買入$AGNC過去幾年證明有利可圖，即使長期國債持續虧損。（引用：自約3年前發布$AGNC作為最佳債券曝險機會（本質上是無信用風險的封閉式槓桿代理MBS基金）以來，其股票年化約15%，儘管長期國債負報酬。近期價格下跌後又開始變得便宜。）

en.text: James56487175 replies that buying $AGNC at local lows has proven lucrative for the past few years even as long-term Treasuries continued to bleed red. (Quoted: In the ~3 years since posted about $AGNC as best bond exposure opp essentially a closed-end levered agency MBS fund with no credit risk, its stock has annualized ~15% despite negative returns on LT Treasuries. Starting to get cheap again after recent price decline.)

zh.text: JonkooTrades發布哇，多麼的一天。我們都看到$DXY的移動了嗎？聯準會又在印鈔票嗎？

en.text: JonkooTrades posts Wow what a day. Did we all see the move on the $DXY? Is the fed printing money again?

zh.text: leadlagreport 指出地緣政治風險上升，油價波動，供應鏈承壓，必須有所改變，$JOJO。

en.text: leadlagreport notes rising geopolitical risk, volatile oil, pressured supply chains, something has to give, $JOJO.

zh.text: 昨天芯片拋售有具體原因：商務部11月16日規則關閉中國公司通過海外數據中心遠程租賃英偉達芯片的漏洞，11月19日生效。賣家在二級市場拋售Blackwell B300 GPU，服務器報價300萬美元對比60萬美元標價。台積電暫停先前許可的中國客戶先進芯片訂單。對$NVDA的解讀是混合的：需求真實，但部分是通過東南亞路由的中國資金現已擱淺。市場正在重新定價哪些AI需求是持久的，哪些是監管套利。

en.text: Yesterday's chip selling had a specific cause: Commerce Department Nov 16 rule closed the loophole letting Chinese firms rent Nvidia chips remotely through overseas data centers, effective Nov 19. Sellers dumped Blackwell B300 GPUs on secondary market, servers quoted $3M vs $600k list. TSMC suspended previously permitted advanced chip orders from Chinese customers. For $NVDA the read is mixed: demand is real but a slice was Chinese money routed through Southeast Asia now stranded. Market is repricing which AI demand is durable versus regulatory arbitrage.
